_help: What goes into SyncWatch's portable Windows runtime (its own Python + libraries). Changing anything here (or in requirements-win.lock) gives the runtime a new id, so the next release builds and uploads a new runtime; otherwise the existing one is reused. Hashes come from python.org and PyPI.

libmpv._help: mpv's video player library for Windows (libmpv-2.dll), from zhongfly/mpv-winbuild. A copy is kept in this repo's pre-release deps-libmpv-<date>-<commit> (made by tools/mirror_libmpv.py, or the "Mirror libmpv" workflow), because the original builds are deleted after a few weeks. Whichever is used, the DLL must have exactly dll_sha256. To update mpv: see tools/mirror_libmpv.py.

_remove_help: Files SyncWatch never uses, taken out after installing: QML, Qt's own translations, build files (metatypes, include, typesystems, glue, objects-*), Qt developer tools (*.exe), type hints (*.pyi) and Cython headers (*.pxd). Patterns are matched against paths inside the runtime ('*' also matches '/').
_max_path_help: Longest allowed path inside the runtime, in characters. Windows Explorer can't unzip paths over 260 characters, including the folder people unzip to, so this keeps plenty of room.
